title: Vatican archives ceremony with Bledsoe's photo

tellings.quote: Yeah, they had a ceremony. They put my picture in the picture of the pope on the outside of the archives and then they placed my photo between the books of Galileo and Capernicus.

plain: Chris Bledsoe is a man who says he has had many encounters with UFOs. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he passed on what he says he was told by two people, Diana Pasulka and Timothy Taylor: around 2017 there was a ceremony at the Vatican archives, the Catholic Church's historic record collection in Vatican City. As he tells it, his photo was put with a picture of the pope outside the archives and then placed between books by the astronomers Galileo and Copernicus, which would mean the Church gave his experiences real weight.
